arxiv-2109-11236.title: Effects of large-scale advection and small-scale turbulent diffusion on vertical phytoplankton dynamics
arxiv-2109-11236.creator: Vinicius Beltram Tergolina, Enrico Calzavarini, Gilmar Mompean, Stefano Berti
arxiv-2109-11236.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vinicius Beltram Tergolina, Enrico Calzavarini, Gilmar Mompean, Stefano Berti. Turbulence has been recognized as a factor of paramount importance for the survival or extinction of sinking phytoplankton species. However, dealing with its multiscale nature in models of coupled fluid and biological dynamics is a formidable challenge. Advection by coherent structures, as those related to winter convection and Langmuir circulation, is also recognized to play a role in the survival and localization of phytoplankton.

arxiv-2507-19780.creator: Zhiming Liu, Paul Hill, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
arxiv-2507-19780.description: Abstract Atmospheric turbulence (AT) introduces severe degradations—such as rippling, blur, and intensity fluctuations—that hinder both image quality and downstream vision tasks like target detection. pmc-11353577.title: Influence of Different Packaging Materials on the Composition of the Headspace of Rennet Cheeses under Different Modified Atmosphere Conditions
pmc-11353577.creator: Justyna Zulewska, Adriana Lobacz, Ireneusz Bialobrzewski, Adam Grochowina, Anna Kaminska, Jinhe Bai, Wenjun Wang, Sadeghi Kambiz

pmc-11473813.title: GRHL2 regulates keratinocyte EMT-MET dynamics and scar formation during cutaneous wound healing
pmc-11473813.creator: Tianying Chen, Bo Zhang, Hanqi Xie, Chenyu Huang, Qiong Wu
pmc-11473813.description: After cutaneous wounds successfully heal, keratinocytes that underwent the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) regain their epithelial characteristics, while in scar tissue, epidermal cells persist in a mesenchymal state. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing this reversion are poorly understood, and the impact of persistent mesenchymal-like epidermal cells in scar tissue remains unclear.

pmc-11608211.title: Spectroelectrochemical insights into the intrinsic nature of lead halide perovskites
pmc-11608211.creator: Seonhong Min, Minwook Jeon, Junsang Cho, Jin Ho Bang, Prashant V Kamat
pmc-11608211.description: Lead halide perovskites have emerged as a new class of semiconductor materials with exceptional optoelectronic properties, sparking significant research interest in photovoltaics and light-emitting diodes. However, achieving long-term operational stability remains a critical hurdle. The soft, ionic nature of the halide perovskite lattice renders them vulnerable to various instabilities.

pmc-11610399.title: Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Patients with Valvular Heart Disease: A Nationwide Observational Cohort Study
pmc-11610399.creator: Qianhong Lu, Junxing Lv, Zhe Li, Yunqing Ye, Bin Zhang, Weiwei Wang, Qinghao Zhao, Haitong Zhang, Zhenyan Zhao, Bincheng Wang, Qingrong Liu, Zikai Yu, Zhenya Duan, Shuai Guo, Yanyan Zhao, Runlin Gao, Haiyan Xu, Yongjian Wu, On behalf of the CHINA-VHD collaborators
pmc-11610399.description: PurposeConventional cardiovascular risk factors may contribute to the development of valvular heart disease (VHD). The present study sought to investigate the distribution of conventional modifiable cardiovascular risk factors (smoking, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and diabetes) in various VHDs, the impact of risk factors on outcomes, and the prognostic indicators in patients with distinct burdens of risk factors.

pmc-11613390.title: Analysis of influencing factors and construction of nomogram prediction model of postoperative kinesiophobia in patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty
pmc-11613390.creator: Jian Xie, Haoliang Cai, Wenting Chen, Xiaohui Wu, Xi Chen, Jun Guo
pmc-11613390.description: Objective:To explore the influencing factors of kinesiophobia and to establish a nomogram prediction model.Methods:A retrospective observational study was conducted in 354 patients who underwent TKA in Shuguang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine from December 2019 to December 2022.

pmc-12446072.title: Unified mass imaging maps the lipidome of vertebrate development
pmc-12446072.creator: Halima Hannah Schede, Leila Haj Abdullah Alieh, Laurel Ann Rohde, Antonio Herrera, Anjalie Schlaeppi, Guillaume Valentin, Alireza Gargoori Motlagh, Albert Dominguez Mantes, Chloe Jollivet, Jonathan Paz-Montoya, Laura Capolupo, Irina Khven, Andrew C. Oates, Giovanni D’Angelo, Gioele La Manno
pmc-12446072.description: Embryo development entails the formation of anatomical structures with distinct biochemical compositions. Compared with the wealth of knowledge on gene regulation, our understanding of metabolic programs operating during embryogenesis is limited. Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) has the potential to map the distribution of metabolites across embryo development.

pmc-12473649.title: Randomized Clinical Trial for the Optimization of Dyslipidemia Management in Patients with End-Stage Renal Disease Undergoing In-Hospital Maintenance Hemodialysis Therapy
pmc-12473649.creator: Sadia Rehman, Muhammad Farhan, Muhammad Raza Sarfraz, Asma Naveed, Fahad Usman, Anila Bibi, Raheel Ahmed, Hiya Huq, Ali Hasan, Jarin Anzoom, Pobitro Kumar
pmc-12473649.description: Background/Objectives: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients on maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) frequently develop L-carnitine (LC) deficiency, leading to dyslipidemia and increased cardiovascular risk. While LC supplementation may improve dyslipidemia, the optimal route of administration remains unclear. This study evaluates the effects of LC on dyslipidemia in MHD patients and compares oral versus intravenous (IV) administration.

pmc-12609404.title: A Multi-Modality Approach to the Assessment of a Right Atrium Mass in a Female Patient with Breast Cancer Undergoing Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
pmc-12609404.creator: Małgorzata Chlabicz, Paweł Muszyński, Joanna Kruszyńska, Piotr Kazberuk, Magdalena Róg-Makal, Magdalena Lipowicz, Urszula Matys, Anna Tomaszuk-Kazberuk, Marcin Kożuch, Sławomir Dobrzycki
pmc-12609404.description: Echocardiography remains a vital part of the initial assessment and monitoring of oncological patients. It allows for proper treatment selection but can also reveal life-threatening complications, including impaired left ventricular function or thromboembolism. It can rarely detect intracardiac masses that require further investigation.

pmc-12632235.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and autoimmune diseases: unravelling complex interactions
pmc-12632235.creator: Alexandr Ceasovschih, Victorița Șorodoc, Anastasia Balta, Mihai Constantin, Bianca Codrina Morărașu, Alexandra-Diana Diaconu, Raluca-Elena Alexa, Andreea Asaftei, Mariana Pavel-Tanasa, Gabriela Rusu-Zota, Alexandru Corlăteanu, Georgia Hardavella, Laurențiu Șorodoc
pmc-12632235.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a global healthcare problem, characterized by a progressive and irreversible decline in lung function, primarily due to airflow limitation caused by inflammation and emphysema. While smoking is the main risk factor, systemic inflammation also plays a significant role in the development and progression of the disease, particularly in relation to autoimmune conditions.

pmc-12691423.title: Phylogenetic Analysis and Public Health Implications of Salmonella Strains in Southwestern States of Nigeria Using InvA Gene Sequences
pmc-12691423.creator: Emmanuel O Fadipe, Ludwig E Hölzle, Júlia Angélica Gonçalves Da Silveira, Felipe M Salvarani, Sheyla Farhayldes Souza Domingues
pmc-12691423.description: Simple SummarySalmonella is a bacterium that can cause severe foodborne illness in humans and is often transmitted through contaminated poultry products. In this study, we collected samples from poultry farms in three states in southwestern Nigeria to determine the prevalence of Salmonella and to characterize the types of present.

pmc-13119957.title: Detect and Repair: Robust Self-Supervised Wearable Sensing Under Missing Modalities
pmc-13119957.creator: Aboul Hassane Cisse, Shoya Ishimaru
pmc-13119957.description: Wearable sensor systems are being increasingly deployed in real-world environments to monitor human activities and cognitive states. However, such systems frequently suffer from degraded or missing sensor modalities due to occlusions, energy constraints, or hardware failures. In this work, we introduce CognifySSL v2.

pmc-13194262.title: Childhood body mass index trajectories and risk of overweight and obesity in young adulthood: a population-based prospective cohort study
pmc-13194262.creator: Jasmin M. de Groot, Janine F. Felix, Romy Gaillard, Vincent W. V. Jaddoe
pmc-13194262.description: Childhood body mass index (BMI) change is associated with obesity in adulthood but is often investigated in isolated age windows. This study aimed to identify age windows of BMI changes that are associated with overweight, including obesity, in young adulthood.

pmc-13352136.title: Early Subspecialty Exposure in Otolaryngology and Its Association With Medical Student Career Interests
pmc-13352136.creator: Kaitlin Hori, Ramon Bustos, Tingyu Yang, Tamara Chambers, Janet S Choi
pmc-13352136.description: ObjectiveOtolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (OHNS) experiences vary across medical schools and are often elective. Early exposure may play a role in shaping medical students' career and subspecialty interests. This study examined the associations of OHNS exposures during medical school with career and subspecialty interests among OHNS residency applicants.Study DesignCross‐sectional survey study.

pmc-13382128.creator: Shunsuke Imamura, Takeshi Uehara, Mai Iwaya, Shiho Asaka, Shinsuke Sugenoya, Hiroshi Sawaguchi, Yasuhiro Kuraishi, Tomoyuki Nakajima, Shotaro Komamura, Akira Nakamura, Takefumi Kimura, Yugo Iwaya, Akira Shimizu, Yuji Soejima, Hiroyoshi Ota, Tadanobu Nagaya

pmc-13490658.title: Analyzing the association between age-related macular degeneration, retinal vascular occlusions, and dementia
pmc-13490658.creator: Ahmed Alshaikhsalama, Krista Thompson, Haafiz Hashim, Kishan G Patel
pmc-13490658.description: PurposeTo investigate the association between age-related macular degeneration (AMD), retinal artery occlusion (RAO), and retinal vein occlusion (RVO) and the future development of Alzheimer's disease (AD), vascular dementia (VaD), and all-cause dementia (ACD).MethodsRetrospective propensity score–matched cohort study using TriNetX, a confederated healthcare network.

pmc-13557704.title: Effect of Marker Ball Positioning on Templating Accuracy in Hip Arthroplasty: A Closed-Loop Audit
pmc-13557704.creator: Heather Tetley, Marcus Cox, André Fernandes, Shaul Gordon, Jamie C Routledge, Smit Shah, Charlie Jowett
pmc-13557704.description: IntroductionPositioning of external calibration devices (ECDs) in anteroposterior (AP) pelvic radiographs influences magnification correction and therefore the accuracy of digital templating in hip arthroplasty. Orthopaedic departments rely on radiology teams to accurately position ECDs on pre-operative radiographs, but due to multiple factors, placement is not always satisfactory, which may incorrectly guide selection of the hip prosthesis size.

pmc-13626903.title: A culturally tailored Zhuang embroidery intervention for psychological well-being among Zhuang adults in the retirement transition in Guangxi: a waitlist-controlled quasi-experimental study
pmc-13626903.creator: Junfeng Li, Junzi Xiang
pmc-13626903.description: BackgroundArts- and craft-based community programs may support psychological well-being in later life, yet few studies have examined culturally tailored ethnic heritage crafts as public health interventions in their communities of origin.MethodsThis waitlist-controlled quasi-experimental study evaluated an eight-week intervention integrating Zhuang embroidery practice, cultural storytelling, and group exchange among community-dwelling Zhuang adults aged 55–65 years in Guangxi, China.
